scope.versions: AC1018 and newer standard OBJECTS common-handle tails
scope.paths: The shared readObjectCommonHandles helper, its table-entry wrapper, and every direct caller

rules.parent: ODA v5.4.1 §20.1 soft pointer; raw soft-pointer offset codes 4, 6, 8, A and C are accepted only on the offset-resolved owner field
rules.reactors: ODA v5.4.1 §20.1 absolute soft pointer, or canonical null
rules.extension_dictionary: ODA v5.4.1 §20.1 hard owner, or canonical null

scope.legacy_behavior: Preserves the existing AC1012/AC1014 DICTIONARY/GROUP-specific validation; no broader pre-AC1018 role policy is introduced.
excluded: object-specific handle fields after the common prefix
body reference closure and DXF role mapping

checks: wrong parent, reactor and xdictionary roles refuse independently
failure preserves the handle cursor and caller output values
corrected input retries successfully on the same probe
relative owner codes 6, 8, A and C resolve under the soft-pointer role
canonical null common handles are accepted
following object-specific handle sentinel remains aligned

version_cohort.includes: AC1018/AC1024 physical read cases and selected bounded generated cohorts

physical_read.cli_exit: conversion stops at the existing strict AC1027 source-reference gate; no output-support claim is promoted

test_vector_corrections: Generated OBJECTS common-parent references that used hard-ownership code 3 now use soft-pointer code 4; owned/body references retain their specified ownership roles.
The known AC1024 PERSUBENTMGR abbreviated source profile is asserted as partial; the AC1027/AC1032 omitted-count controls remain negative.
fixture_policy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added; role regressions are generated in memory, and the physical source is an existing ACadSharp repository sample.
claim_limit: This validates common OBJECTS handle roles across the implemented AC1018+ shared helper paths and one physical AC1027 read profile. It does not establish all body-reference closure or strict output support.
